# Aurelix tools

> Aurelix builds pay-per-result web data tools that run on the Apify Store (https://apify.com/aurelix). Each tool reads only public pages a logged-out visitor can see (no login, no cookies, no CAPTCHA solving) and returns clean rows as JSON, CSV or Excel, through the Apify API, schedules, integrations (Google Sheets, Zapier, Make, n8n) or the Apify MCP server for AI agents. Prices below are live Store prices at the last site rebuild.

## Tools

- [Greenhouse Jobs Scraper](https://aurelix-solutions.github.io/tools/greenhouse-jobs-scraper/): Live jobs from a company's Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby or SmartRecruiters board, with salary and Canadian province tags. Price: $1.50 per 1,000 jobs ($1.05 on paid Apify plans). Run it: https://apify.com/aurelix/greenhouse-jobs-scraper (Actor id aurelix/greenhouse-jobs-scraper).
- [Canada Building Permits](https://aurelix-solutions.github.io/tools/canada-building-permits-scraper/): Building permits and development applications from 7 Canadian cities: address, type, status, dates, value, contractor company. Price: $3.00 per 1,000 applications ($2.10 on paid Apify plans). Run it: https://apify.com/aurelix/canada-building-permits-scraper (Actor id aurelix/canada-building-permits-scraper).
- [Amazon New Releases & Best Sellers](https://aurelix-solutions.github.io/tools/amazon-best-sellers/): Amazon Best Sellers and New Releases top 100 on 10 marketplaces: rank, ASIN, price, rating, rank change. Price: $0.55 per 1,000 products ($0.38 on paid Apify plans). Run it: https://apify.com/aurelix/amazon-best-sellers (Actor id aurelix/amazon-best-sellers).
- [LinkedIn Jobs Country Filter Scraper](https://aurelix-solutions.github.io/tools/linkedin-jobs/): Public LinkedIn job postings by keyword and country: title, company, location, seniority, job type, salary text, description. Price: $1.50 per 1,000 jobs ($1.05 on paid Apify plans). Run it: https://apify.com/aurelix/linkedin-jobs (Actor id aurelix/linkedin-jobs).
- [AliExpress Scraper](https://aurelix-solutions.github.io/tools/aliexpress-product-search/): AliExpress search results by keyword: price, discount, rating, units sold, ship-from country and sponsored flag. Price: $1.80 per 1,000 products ($1.26 on paid Apify plans). Run it: https://apify.com/aurelix/aliexpress-product-search (Actor id aurelix/aliexpress-product-search).
- [Google Trends by Region](https://aurelix-solutions.github.io/tools/google-trends-scraper/): Google Trends interest over time, by region and rising queries for any number of keywords, plus trending searches. Price: $1.50 per 1,000 results ($0.90 on paid Apify plans). Run it: https://apify.com/aurelix/google-trends-scraper (Actor id aurelix/google-trends-scraper).
- [Google Maps Phone Scraper](https://aurelix-solutions.github.io/tools/google-maps-scraper/): Local business lists from Google Maps: phones, websites, ratings, hours, coordinates; optional website emails and socials. Price: $0.85 per 1,000 places ($0.75 on paid Apify plans). Run it: https://apify.com/aurelix/google-maps-scraper (Actor id aurelix/google-maps-scraper).
- [Facebook Ad Library Search & API](https://aurelix-solutions.github.io/tools/facebook-ad-library-scraper/): Facebook and Instagram business ads from the Meta Ad Library: copy, creatives, landing pages, dates, optional EU reach. Price: $0.70 per 1,000 ads ($0.60 on paid Apify plans). Run it: https://apify.com/aurelix/facebook-ad-library-scraper (Actor id aurelix/facebook-ad-library-scraper).
- [Website to Markdown API](https://aurelix-solutions.github.io/tools/website-to-markdown/): Crawls a site and returns one row of clean main-content Markdown per page, with title, headings and links. Price: $0.65 per 1,000 pages ($0.60 on paid Apify plans). Run it: https://apify.com/aurelix/website-to-markdown (Actor id aurelix/website-to-markdown).
- [Recently Funded Companies](https://aurelix-solutions.github.io/tools/recently-funded-companies/): US companies that just filed an SEC Form D: amount raised, industry, state, executives, confirmed website. Price: $5.00 per 1,000 filings ($3.50 on paid Apify plans). Run it: https://apify.com/aurelix/recently-funded-companies (Actor id aurelix/recently-funded-companies).
- [Multi Job Board Scraper](https://aurelix-solutions.github.io/tools/multi-job-board-scraper/): LinkedIn, about 50 company career sites, Remote OK and We Work Remotely jobs in one deduplicated list. Price: $1.50 per 1,000 jobs ($0.90 on paid Apify plans). Run it: https://apify.com/aurelix/multi-job-board-scraper (Actor id aurelix/multi-job-board-scraper).
- [Competitor Watch](https://aurelix-solutions.github.io/tools/competitor-watch/): One report per competitor with only what is new: Meta and TikTok ads, page changes, Shopify products and prices, jobs. Price: $30.00 per 1,000 competitor checks ($27.00 on paid Apify plans). Run it: https://apify.com/aurelix/competitor-watch (Actor id aurelix/competitor-watch).
- [Funded Companies Hiring](https://aurelix-solutions.github.io/tools/funded-companies-hiring/): Companies that just raised money (SEC Form D), with their open roles and business contacts, as a new-only monitor. Price: $20.00 per 1,000 hiring companies ($16.00 on paid Apify plans). Run it: https://apify.com/aurelix/funded-companies-hiring (Actor id aurelix/funded-companies-hiring).
- [PDF to Markdown OCR & Table Extraction](https://aurelix-solutions.github.io/tools/pdf-to-markdown/): Turns linked PDF and Word files into Markdown per page, with tables as JSON rows, RAG chunks and OCR. Price: $0.30 per 1,000 pages ($0.25 on paid Apify plans). Run it: https://apify.com/aurelix/pdf-to-markdown (Actor id aurelix/pdf-to-markdown).
- [Google Autocomplete API](https://aurelix-solutions.github.io/tools/google-autocomplete-scraper/): Expands seed keywords into hundreds of real Google and YouTube autocomplete phrases, tagged by search intent. Price: $0.45 per 1,000 keywords ($0.35 on paid Apify plans). Run it: https://apify.com/aurelix/google-autocomplete-scraper (Actor id aurelix/google-autocomplete-scraper).
- [Amazon Sponsored Products & Search Results Scraper](https://aurelix-solutions.github.io/tools/amazon-product-search/): Scrape Amazon search results for any keyword at $0.10 per 1,000 products: position, ASIN, title, price, list price, rating, review count, Prime, sponsored flag and badges, up to 20 pages per search, on amazon.com and amazon.ca. No login; only-new-products mode. Price: $0.10 per 1,000 products ($0.08 on paid Apify plans). Run it: https://apify.com/aurelix/amazon-product-search (Actor id aurelix/amazon-product-search).
- [Broken Link Crawler & SEO Audit](https://aurelix-solutions.github.io/tools/seo-audit-crawler/): Audits a whole site: one row per page with SEO checks and broken links, plus a ranked issues summary. Price: $2.50 per 1,000 pages ($1.75 on paid Apify plans). Run it: https://apify.com/aurelix/seo-audit-crawler (Actor id aurelix/seo-audit-crawler).
- [Tech Stack API](https://aurelix-solutions.github.io/tools/tech-stack-detector/): CMS, e-commerce platform, analytics, ad pixels, chat, CDN and email provider for each domain you enter. Price: $1.50 per 1,000 domains ($1.05 on paid Apify plans). Run it: https://apify.com/aurelix/tech-stack-detector (Actor id aurelix/tech-stack-detector).

## Guides

- [LinkedIn job alerts in Slack without logging in to LinkedIn](https://aurelix-solutions.github.io/tools/guides/linkedin-job-alerts-slack-without-login/): Get a Slack message with only the new LinkedIn jobs for your keywords and country, every morning, without a LinkedIn account or cookies. Working input, real output and the Python version.
- [Get recently funded startups into a Google Sheet every day, from SEC Form D filings](https://aurelix-solutions.github.io/tools/guides/recently-funded-startups-google-sheets/): A daily Google Sheet of US companies that just reported raising money (amount, industry, state, website), built from official SEC Form D filings with a short Python script.
- [Track Amazon New Releases daily and catch new products as they enter the list](https://aurelix-solutions.github.io/tools/guides/track-amazon-new-releases-daily/): Save Amazon's Hot New Releases top 100 for any category every day, flag the products that just entered, and spot new launches with few reviews, with a short Python script.
- [Toronto development applications for contractors - a weekly list of new projects from open data](https://aurelix-solutions.github.io/tools/guides/toronto-development-applications-for-contractors/): Pull new Toronto rezoning, site plan and condominium applications (address, ward, storeys, units) from the City's open data every week, filter them for your trade, and get them into a spreadsheet.
- [Export Google Maps search results to CSV or Google Sheets, for many cities at once](https://aurelix-solutions.github.io/tools/guides/export-google-maps-search-results-to-csv/): Turn "roofing contractor in Calgary" style Google Maps searches into a spreadsheet with phone, website, rating, review count, hours and coordinates, across many cities in one run, without the Places API or a Google account.
- [Find a competitor's longest-running Facebook and Instagram ads with the Meta Ad Library](https://aurelix-solutions.github.io/tools/guides/longest-running-facebook-ads-competitor/): Pull every active ad a brand runs from the Meta Ad Library, sort by how long each has been running, and export the copy, landing pages and formats of the ones they keep paying for. No Facebook login or API token.
- [Compare more than 5 keywords in Google Trends on one scale, and export them to CSV](https://aurelix-solutions.github.io/tools/guides/compare-google-trends-many-keywords-one-scale/): Google Trends compares at most 5 terms at a time. Here is how to put 50 or 500 keywords on one shared 0-100 scale with an anchor keyword, and export interest over time, top regions and rising queries to a spreadsheet.
- [Turn a documentation site into one Markdown file for ChatGPT, Claude or Cursor](https://aurelix-solutions.github.io/tools/guides/documentation-site-to-markdown-for-chatgpt-claude/): Crawl a docs site, strip menus, footers and cookie banners, and merge every page into a single Markdown file (or an llms-full.txt) you can upload to ChatGPT, Claude, a Claude Project or Cursor.

## Weekly lead feeds

- [Toronto New Projects](https://aurelix-solutions.github.io/toronto/): Weekly spreadsheet of new Toronto building permit and development applications for contractors.
- [Calgary New Projects](https://aurelix-solutions.github.io/calgary/): Weekly City of Calgary building permits issued and early leads.
- [Vancouver New Projects](https://aurelix-solutions.github.io/vancouver/): Weekly City of Vancouver building permits issued.
- [Ontario New Venues](https://aurelix-solutions.github.io/ontario-venues/): Weekly Ontario liquor-licence applications and newly licensed venues, for suppliers to new restaurants and bars.
